body: [muse watermelon-full-preview] Partially delivered on main: install-units --bridge NAME (repeatable) writes persistent agentctl-bridge-NAME.service (chat run --bridge-state REGISTRY/bridges/NAME, ordered after herdr-server), replacing the systemd-run transient; services refresh then updates it in place as a unit file, and restore already starts configured units that are missing. Herdr server, boot restore and watch units were already persistent. Remaining: a rendered .timer unit still needs the team spec schedule/command (#742 restore-team-spec, other lane), and the certificate wait lives in restore --boot (#742). Left open for the timer slice once the spec lands.
